title: OZMAFIA!!
description:
After waking in a mysterious town without any memories, you quickly find yourself embroiled in the war between several mafia famiglia and sheltered by the Oz famiglia. 

As you attempt to find your place in this town, several handsome men vie for your attention.

Who will you choose to trust? To love? Can you find a place to call your own? Can you bring peace to the town?

Be prepared for drama when you enter one of the Oz Famiglia's routes, because whoever's currently in second for your affection will continue vying for it! Will you stick your current partner, or will you fall their rival instead? The choice is yours!

Listen to the famous talent of actors like Shingaki Tarusuke (Nathaniel, Bungo Stray Dogs; Eishiro, Prince of Tennis), Okitsu Kazuyuki (Zantetsu, Blue Lock; Kotetsu, Touken Ranbu), Kakehashi Atsushi (Luthier, Fire Emblem Heroes, Laurus, Galtia), and many others as they woo your heart!

Enjoy beautiful, watercolor artwork from Satoi, the artist of Diabolik Lovers, Norn 9, and Olympia Soirée.
description_short: Enjoy a dramatic romance in this fairytale otome visual novel. Who will you decide to trust and fall in love with in this mysterious town where fairytales have become warring mafia famiglia? Explore this exciting world through a dozen routes and 20+ endings!
